tasks.title: Status button not updating from text entered after session close
tasks.description: When a session is closed, any status text entered in the status input field is not being reflected in the UI. The status button should update to show the new text immediately when it's submitted, regardless of whether the session is still active. Investigation needed to determine if this is a client-side state sync issue, a WebSocket connection drop, or a server-side persistence problem.

tasks.title: LangGraph: Integration + POC Validation (Phases 6-7)
tasks.description: Add backlog.json write-locking, validate checkpoint restart survival mid-task, run one complete task end-to-end through /lang, and document POC findings. Determines whether /lang is ready to mature beyond POC. Depends on Task #33.

tasks.title: Upgrade project memory into ranked retrieval
tasks.description: QueryMemory currently loads Obsidian markdown files and can return all memory at once, which creates prompt bloat and weak relevance control. Add a local retrieval layer with chunking, lexical plus semantic ranking, freshness signals, project and task metadata, cited snippets, and retrieval traces. Default QueryMemory to top relevant excerpts while preserving an escape hatch for full-file reads.

tasks.title: Wire evaluatePolicy into tool execution
tasks.description: Replace assertWritable + assertSafeCommand + detectInstallerExe call sites in toolBash, toolPowerShell, toolWrite, and toolEdit with evaluatePolicy. Consolidate the duplicated shell precheck sequence (assertSafeCommand + detectInstallerExe + detectShellWriteTargets + backupBeforeWrite + snapshotForShellEncodingCheck) that currently appears identically in both toolBash and toolPowerShell into a single shellPrecheck(command, workDir, sessionId, policy) helper. No behavior changes â€” enforcement must be identical to what existed before.

tasks.title: Policy unit test suite
tasks.description: Write unit tests for evaluatePolicy covering: one test per COMMAND_CLASS_REGISTRY entry (each class is blocked at standard trust level), write boundary check (path outside allowedRoots is denied), extended write mode allows Obsidian path, installer gate blocks when installerAllowed=false, installer gate allows when installerAllowed=true. Tests should run without a live server â€” evaluatePolicy must be importable in isolation.

tasks.title: Expand agent evals into product-critical acceptance suites
tasks.description: The existing agent eval harness is a strong seed, but it is too small to guard Polaris's behavior as the system grows. Add suites for tool choice, permission refusal, QueryMemory fallback, Cross-Check approval and rejection, backlog transitions, model regressions, latency, token cost, retry behavior, and failure recovery. Report pass rate, tool-call count, token use, latency, and regression deltas in concise scorecards.

tasks.title: Make trust, proof, cost, and recovery visible in the product
tasks.description: Polaris's strongest product idea is an AI command center with trust rails, not just parallel agent sessions. Bring task state, proof state, risk state, Cross-Check state, and cost state into a clearer first-class workflow surface. Add explanations for why a session is waiting, one-click recovery from failed gates, and a guided task lane for plan, build, review, stage, and production promotion.

tasks.title: Wire runtime validation: use compiled contracts in server.js
tasks.description: Add tsc build step to package.json scripts so contracts compile to dist/contracts/. In server.js, replace hand-rolled backlog validation (VALID_BACKLOG_STATUSES, _validImpact, field checks) with compiled Zod validators. Add WebSocket receive-side validation so malformed messages are rejected with a structured error. No changes to business logic â€” validation only.

tasks.title: Registry generation: generate docs/registries/ from schemas
tasks.description: Write scripts/generate-registries.js that imports compiled contract modules from dist/contracts/ and generates docs/registries/websocket-messages.md, backlog-task-fields.md, tool-schemas.md, and mcp-envelopes.md. Add npm script "generate:registries". Run it to regenerate all current registries and verify output matches existing hand-written content.

tasks.title: Auto-purge stale session worktrees
tasks.description: Polaris creates a git worktree under %TEMP%\polaris-wt\ for every chat session but never cleans them up. Over time these accumulate (60+ directories observed). Add a startup sweep (and optionally a periodic timer) that removes worktrees older than 7 days: (1) list all registered worktrees via git worktree list --porcelain, (2) skip the main worktree and any branch-named worktrees (task/* or wip/*), (3) for detached-HEAD worktrees whose directory mtime is older than the threshold, run git worktree remove --force, (4) log each removal to the existing Polaris health/log channel. Threshold should be a constant (DEFAULT_WORKTREE_TTL_DAYS = 7) near the top of server.js. The sweep must never remove a worktree whose session is still open (check against active sessionStore entries by matching the worktree path).
